# PulseAtlas

PulseAtlas is a source-aware public COVID-19 reporting dashboard built with Next.js and TypeScript.

## Main features

- Global COVID-19 totals
- Searchable country index
- Country detail pages
- Historical trend charts
- Interactive world map
- Reporting updates
- Methodology and source catalog
- Light and dark themes

## Data sources

PulseAtlas combines public reporting from:

- disease.sh
- World Health Organization downloadable datasets
- Our World in Data archives
- DataHub CSV feeds

Third-party data is fetched server-side and normalized into internal application types before it reaches the interface.

## Technical summary

- Next.js 16
- React 19
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4
- Zod validation
- Recharts
- react-svg-worldmap
- d3-dsv

## Repository

https://github.com/Nischhalsubba/corona_tracker

## Health and data disclaimer

PulseAtlas is an informational data dashboard, not a medical service or official public-health authority. It does not provide diagnosis, treatment, emergency advice, or individualized medical recommendations.

COVID-19 reporting can be delayed, revised, incomplete, differently defined across countries, or discontinued by upstream providers. Always review the source label and update time before relying on a figure. For current health guidance, consult official national health authorities, the World Health Organization, or a qualified healthcare professional.
